outing.hero_prompt_english: Yunju Temple in Fangshan at the foot of low western hills: warm red timber temple roofs layered behind an ancient pale brick pagoda, stone-paved courtyard, protected stone-sutra display suggested only as blank inscribed-like texture without readable characters. An adult studies architecture beneath autumn branches; no copying actual sutra pages or murals. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
